newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom has more than one mln GSM users.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom has more than one mln GSM users.

text.p: France Telecom said its Itineris digital GSM telecommunications unit had reached the one million users mark in Augsut 1996, one month ahead of schedule.
It said it now had a market share of 65 percent of the market and it expects 1.25 million users by the end of 1996.
Itineris, launched in the second half of 1992, had 79,000 users at the end of 1993, 370,000 at the end of 1994 and 700,700 at the end of 1995.
France Telecom said all users would get 30 minutes free calling time to celebrate the milestone.
